description: The nightly's full run names its container as a flow map written tight, `{image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright}`, with no tag — Docker's `latest`. The name ends at the brace. Two earlier versions of the pattern listed what may end a name — quotes and spaces, then `,` `}` `]` as well — and the first of them did not see this mention at all; a mention it does not see carries no version to refuse. The pattern now ends the name at anything that cannot continue it.

workflows..github/workflows/nightly.yml:
jobs:
  full:
    container: {image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright}
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx run-many -t e2e
  flake:
    container: { image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-resolute, options: --user 1001 }
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
